target_change: Move from memorised agent labels to reconstructing agent role from species identity, oxidation-state change and electron consequence.

stages.prompt: Which element must you track on both sides before naming any role?
Complete the oxidation-state lanes for Zn and Cu without looking at the answer.
Connect each state change to electron loss or gain, then to the effect on the other species.
stages.cognitive_job: causal bridge from state to role

stages.prompt: Why is the reducing agent itself oxidised? State the rule in your own words.

stage_selection_reason: This concept fails when learners jump directly to agent labels, so the dialogue forces identity, representation and causal connection before formal naming.

misconception_branches.learner_self_identification_cue: I called the species that is reduced the reducing agent.
misconception_branches.corrective_prompt: Separate SELF change from OTHER effect: what happened to this species, and what did that cause in the other species?
